summary: Tour Jeep careened off a cliff at County Road 361 (Drinking Cup), killing the driver - an OMRT rescue team member - and two clients. Ambulance and Ouray Fire confirmed the fatalities; OMRT lowered two rescuers to extricate the bodies from near Canyon Creek.
notes: Three fatalities including the driver, a respected OMRT member.
